results.title: Russian forces active in uranium-rich West Africa
results.description: Russia is doubling down on its military role in Africa despite the growing demands of its war in Ukraine, with the latest example featuring a direct intervention in recent days by Russian military forces to help Niger's military junta suppress a mutiny.

results.title: UN committee says countries must consider reparations for slave trade
results.description: A UN committee said countries are legally obliged to consider reparations for the transatlantic slave trade and take other measures to address the enduring legacy of racial discrimination it says persists today.
